Specification: This module specifies a message-passing abstraction in which messages are stored in a state variable as a function from message values to delivery counts. It models delivery, loss, timeout detection, processing, and sending of requests and responses, with message loss represented by a count of -1 and processed messages represented by decrementing or clearing counts. The module provides helper predicates and actions for identifying receivable messages, clearing or ignoring timed-out or superseded messages, and sending messages to a single recipient or an ensemble, but it does not define a full temporal system specification in this file.
